description: Check an IBAN's structure and check digits for 70+ countries, offline. It never claims the account exists or who owns it. Free, no token.

expectedCountry.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of the party being paid.

iban.description: The account number to check, as written — spaces and dashes are fine, e.g. "BE68 5390 0754 7034".

name: verify_iban
